title: E-Beam Probing: A Revolutionary Solution for Backside Power Delivery Network (PDN) and Backside Power Vias in Advanced Integrated Circuits
content: The increasing complexity of modern integrated circuits, particularly those with multiple power domains and high-performance requirements, has necessitated the adoption of backside power delivery networks and backside power vias. These innovations play a crucial role in mitigating power integrity challenges such as voltage drops, power noise, and thermal effects. However, the characterization and debugging of these structures remain significant challenges due to the inaccessibility of internal metal layers when using traditional probing techniques. E-beam probing emerges as a viable solution, offering deep penetration capabilities, high spatial resolution, and non-invasive measurement techniques. Unlike optical probing, which is limited by diffraction constraints and substrate transparency, e-beam probing can penetrate semiconductor materials to directly access buried power network structures [1,4]. This characteristic makes it an invaluable tool for analyzing backside power delivery networks and identifying potential issues that could affect IC performance and reliability.
